newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Pope excommunicates Sri Lankan priest.
newsitem.headline: Pope excommunicates Sri Lankan priest.

text.p: Sri Lankan priest Tissa Balasuriya has been excommunicated for challenging fundamental beliefs of the Catholic Church, Oswaldo Padilla, Vatican Ambassador to the island, said on Sunday.
The Catholic Bishop's Conference is expected to make a statement on the issue later on Sunday or on Monday, he told Reuters.
Father Balasuriya told Reuters he could not comment until he was officially informed of the decision.
Church officials said, however, they believed it was the first time a Sri Lankan priest had been excommunicated.

The decision was made after Balasuriya refused to retract claims made in his book "Mary and Human Liberation", published by his Centre for Society and Religion, in which he questioned fundamental Catholic beliefs like Baptism and original sin.

Balasuriya refused to sign a Profession of Faith, especially drafted for him by the Church, during a meeting with Padilla last month, saying the statement was not in keeping with current theological thinking and that his conscience would not allow him to sign.
He had also made a direct appeal to Pope John Paul over moves to excommunicate him.
